Polybutylene (Poly-B) pipe replacement in Vancouver costs $4,500 to $35,000 in 2026, depending on property type and size. BC homeowners with Poly-B plumbing face a growing insurance crisis: major carriers are declining to renew policies, and lenders are requiring certification before financing. Reno Stars has completed Poly-B re-pipes across Richmond, Vancouver, Burnaby, and Surrey in 2025 and 2026.

What Is Poly-B and Why Does It Fail?

Polybutylene (Poly-B) is a grey plastic plumbing pipe installed in homes built between 1985 and 1997 across British Columbia. It was marketed as a cheap, easy-to-install alternative to copper — and at the time, it was. The problem is in the fittings: Poly-B fittings used acetal plastic or copper crimp rings, both of which degrade when exposed to oxidised chemicals in municipal water supplies. Over 15 to 30 years, these fittings become brittle, crack, and cause leaks. A single Poly-B failure inside a wall or ceiling can cause $15,000 to $60,000 in water damage — and most home insurance policies do not cover gradual pipe failure.

Warning Signs Your Poly-B Pipes Are Failing

  • Brown or rust-coloured water from taps
  • Stains on walls, ceilings, or floors near water lines
  • Low water pressure in one or more fixtures
  • Visible cracks or bulges on exposed pipe fittings
  • Unexplained increases in your water bill
  • Your home was built between 1985 and 1997 and has never had a plumbing inspection

The Poly-B Replacement Process: Step by Step

Reno Stars completes most Poly-B re-pipes in a single-family home in 5 to 10 working days:

  • Day 1–2: Plumbing inspection and pressure test. We locate all Poly-B supply lines and assess fitting condition.
  • Day 2–3: Permit application (City of Vancouver, Richmond, Burnaby, Surrey, Coquitlam, or other municipality).
  • Day 3–7: Re-piping with PEX-A tubing (lifetime transferable warranty) or Type M copper. All connections are made with commercial-grade fittings.
  • Day 8: Pressure test and system flush — verified by a licensed plumber's sign-off.
  • Day 9–10: Drywall repair, repainting, and final inspection.
  • Day 10: Insurance documentation package delivered — includes plumber's letter, pressure test certificate, and before/after photos.

Insurance: What BC Homeowners Need to Know

As of 2024–2026, major BC home insurers — including Aviva, Intact, and belairdirect — are requiring a plumbing inspection or Poly-B testing report before renewing policies on homes built between 1985 and 1997. Homes that fail or cannot produce documentation are being non-renewed or placed on high-risk Rider 7 policies with premiums of $3,000 to $8,000 per year.

Reno Stars provides a complete insurance documentation package with every Poly-B replacement: licensed plumber's sign-off, pressure test certificate, and before/after photographic evidence. This package is formatted to meet BC property insurer requirements.

Homes with documented Poly-B replacement typically recover their re-pipe investment through:

  • Insurance savings: $1,200–$4,000 per year in avoided high-risk Rider 7 premiums
  • Resale value: Unencumbered, certified plumbing removes a lender condition and speeds up possession timelines
  • Peace of mind: A Reno Stars PEX re-pipe carries a lifetime workmanship warranty — transferable to the next owner

A $15,000 Poly-B replacement typically pays back in 3 to 6 years through insurance savings alone, before accounting for the avoided risk of a $30,000+ water damage claim.

Frequently Asked Questions

How do I know if my home has Poly-B pipes?

Homes built between 1985 and 1997 in BC are the primary risk group. Poly-B pipe is typically grey, runs along main supply lines, and is most visible in basements, crawl spaces, and utility rooms. Look for stamps reading "PB2110" or "Polybutylene" on visible pipe. A licensed plumber's inspection confirms it in under an hour.

Does homeowners insurance cover Poly-B pipe failure?

Most standard BC home insurance policies explicitly exclude "gradual deterioration" or "pipe failure" from coverage. Sudden Poly-B burst events may be covered under sudden-occurrence provisions, but the claim triggers a future non-renewal. Proactive replacement is almost always cheaper than a claim plus premium increase.

What pipe material is used in replacement — PEX or copper?

Reno Stars uses PEX-A tubing as the standard replacement. PEX-A is flexible, freeze-resistant, carries a lifetime transferable warranty, and costs 30–40% less than copper to install. Copper is available as a premium option where code requires it or where the homeowner prefers it.

How long does a full Poly-B re-pipe take in a Vancouver home?

A single-family home in Vancouver typically takes 5 to 10 working days from inspection to final sign-off. Townhouses are faster (3–7 days); larger character homes with multiple floors take longer. Reno Stars coordinates permits directly with each municipality.

Can I sell my home without replacing Poly-B pipes?

You can — but lenders and insurers increasingly require a Poly-B certification as a condition of financing and insurance renewal. Many deals fall through at the financing condition stage when buyers receive a lender's water-diligence requirement. Replacing Poly-B before listing removes this condition and typically recoups its cost through a cleaner sale process.

Polybutylene（Poly-B）是一种灰色塑料水管，安装于1985年至1997年间建造的房屋中。它曾被视为铜管的廉价替代品——但问题在于接头：Poly-B 接头使用 乙缩醛塑料 或 铜压接环，两者在与市政供水中氧化化学物质接触后都会降解。经过15至30年，接头变脆、破裂并导致漏水。一根藏在墙内或天花板中的 Poly-B 故障可造成 $15,000 至 $60,000 的水损——而大多数房屋保险政策不承保渐进性管道故障。

常见问题

如何知道我的房屋是否有 Poly-B 水管？

1985年至1997年间建造的BC省房屋是主要风险群体。Poly-B 水管通常为灰色，沿主要供水管线铺设，在地下室、爬行空间和设备房中最明显。寻找标有 "PB2110" 或 "Polybutylene" 的可见管道。持牌水管工的检验可在不到一小时内确认。

房屋保险是否覆盖 Poly-B 管道故障？

大多数标准 BC 房屋保险政策明确排除"渐进性恶化"或"管道故障"的覆盖。突发的 Poly-B 爆裂事件可能根据"突发事件"条款获得理赔，但索赔会在未来触发续保拒绝。主动更换几乎总是比索赔加保费上涨更划算。

更换使用什么管道材料——PEX 还是铜管？

Reno Stars 使用 PEX-A 管作为标准更换材料。PEX-A 柔韧、抗冻、享有终身可转让保修，安装成本比铜管低30–40%。在规范要求或业主偏好的情况下，铜管可作为高级选项提供。

温哥华房屋全套 Poly-B 更换需要多长时间？

温哥华独立屋从检验到最终签字通常需要5至10个工作日。联排别墅更快（3–7天）；多层大型特色房屋时间更长。Reno Stars 直接与各市政当局协调许可证事宜。

不更换 Poly-B 能否出售房屋？

可以——但贷款机构和保险公司越来越多地要求将 Poly-B 认证作为融资和保险续保的条件。当买家收到贷方的水患尽职调查要求时，许多交易会在融资条件阶段告吹。在挂牌前更换 Poly-B 可消除这一条件，并通过更顺利的销售流程收回成本。
